scenes.title: Hermann Ebbinghaus in 1885 Berlin reciting 'WID, ZOF, KAF' cards to a 150-bpm wooden metronome beside his 20-min-to-31-day Forgetting Curve

layout.description: Sunlit 1885 Berlin scholar's study with tall casement windows, a solid walnut desk holding neatly bundled stacks of 2,300 hand-lettered white index cards ('WID', 'ZOF', 'KAF', 'DAX'), a pyramid-shaped wooden mechanical metronome set to 150 bpm, a pocket stopwatch, and a large hand-plotted graph easel showing the steep 58% -> 44% -> 34% -> 21% curve.

positions.who: Hermann Ebbinghaus (mannequin in 1885 wool frock coat, waistcoat, and spectacles)
positions.where: seated upright at the walnut desk flipping 'WID — ZOF — KAF' index cards in crisp rhythm with the swinging metronome arm while logging relearning seconds in his bound ledger

positions.who: Berlin Faculty Colleague mannequin (in 1885 dark wool jacket)
positions.where: standing beside the plotted curve easel inspecting the steep 1-hour savings drop against the 31-day retention tail

props.name: 13-card 'WID / ZOF / KAF' nonsense-syllable deck & 2,300-card box
props.period_detail: crisp hand-inked 3-letter cards arranged in wooden compartments
props.physical_behavior: Ebbinghaus's invention for stripping away prior meaning

props.name: pyramid wooden 150-bpm metronome & pocket timer
props.period_detail: swinging brass pendulum keeping strict 0.4-second cadence per syllable
props.physical_behavior: enforced scientific precision in a one-man experiment

props.name: 1885 Forgetting Curve chart ('20m: 58% | 1h: 44% | 1d: 34% | 31d: 21%')
props.period_detail: large cream-paper graph showing the vertical first-hour plunge and flat 31-day tail
props.physical_behavior: history's first mathematical graph of human memory

actions.verb_sequence: starts the 150-bpm metronome -> flips rapidly through the 13-syllable card deck reciting rhythmically -> clicks pocket timer and plots the sharp 1-hour drop (44.2%) and 31-day tail (21.1%) on the graph

reactions.reaction: circles the 24-hour overnight plateau and notes 38 spaced reps beating 68 crammed reps

scenes.wardrobe: 1885 German academic wool coat, high-buttoned waistcoat, crisp white collar, round wire spectacles.
scenes.recognition_hook: One stubborn man, a ticking metronome, and 2,300 fake words like 'ZOF' proved over half of raw learning vanishes in sixty minutes.

key_visual.description: an 1885 scholar at a walnut desk flipping hand-lettered 'WID / ZOF / KAF' index cards to a wooden pyramid metronome beside a plotted Forgetting Curve chart

scenes.title: 2015 Amsterdam Replication: 130 Years Apart, Same Exact Curve

layout.description: Bright modern lab desk where a 22-year-old student finishes 70 hours of syllable lists as Murre & Dros overlay the 2015 curve directly onto Ebbinghaus's 1885 dots.

positions.where: completing the 31-day relearning list on screen
pointing to the near-identical 1885 vs 2015 curves including the 24-hour overnight sleep bounce

props.name: 1885 vs 2015 dual-curve overlay display
props.period_detail: almost indistinguishable decay from 20 minutes to 31 days

actions.verb_sequence: overlays 2015 data points onto 1885 curve -> lines match across all 7 intervals

scenes.recognition_hook: Repeat Ebbinghaus's 70-hour syllable marathon in 2015, and a modern human brain lands almost dot-for-dot on his 1885 curve.

scenes.title: Nonsense Syllables vs Lord Byron's Poetry (10x Meaning Velcro)

layout.description: Same walnut desk contrasting a tall stack of 80 repetition tallies for nonsense syllables beside a tiny 8-repetition stack for a stanza of Don Juan.

positions.where: holding open a slim poetry volume in one hand and a thick nonsense stack in the other

props.name: 10-to-1 repetition tally stacks
props.period_detail: meaningful verse needed 1/10th the repetitions of disconnected syllables
props.physical_behavior: debunks misapplying the 1-hour cliff to meaningful stories

actions.verb_sequence: places 8-rep poetry stack beside 80-rep syllable stack

scenes.recognition_hook: Connected meaning cuts learning effort tenfold — only naked, unlinked facts fall straight off the 60-minute cliff.

scenes.title: Flattening the Cliff With Four Spaced Checkpoints

layout.description: Sunlit tidy desk with four spaced calendar review cards (+1 Hour, +1 Day, +3 Days, +7 Days) lifting the curve up toward 90%.

positions.where: completing a brisk 5-minute Day-3 recall check and watching the retention curve flatten near the top

props.name: Spaced Sawtooth Curve board ('+1h / +1d / +3d / +7d')
props.period_detail: visualizes each brief retrieval resetting and flattening decay

actions.verb_sequence: flips three recall cards at Day 3 -> retention line jumps back to 95% with a shallower slope

reactions.reaction: closes deck in 5 minutes instead of cramming for 3 hours

scenes.recognition_hook: Interrupt the curve right before it bends — four short spaced checks beat one exhausting all-nighter every single time.
